title: UltraVoice: Scaling Fine-Grained Style-Controlled Speech Conversations for Spoken Dialogue Models
abstract: arXiv:2510.22588v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Spoken dialogue models currently lack the ability for fine-grained speech style control, a critical capability for human-like interaction that is often overlooked in favor of purely functional capabilities like reasoning and question answering. To address this limitation, we introduce UltraVoice, the first large-scale speech dialogue dataset engineered for multiple fine-grained speech style control. Encompassing over 830 hours of speech dialogues, UltraVoice provides instructions across six key speech stylistic dimensions: emotion, speed, volume, accent, language, and composite styles. Fine-tuning leading models such as SLAM-Omni and VocalNet on UltraVoice significantly enhances their fine-grained speech stylistic controllability without degrading core conversational abilities. translated_title: UltraVoice：为语音对话模型扩展细粒度风格控制的语音对话数据集
translated_abstract: 语音对话模型目前缺乏细粒度语音风格控制的能力，而这是实现类人交互的一项关键能力，却常常被忽视，人们更青睐推理和问答等纯功能性能力。为了解决这一局限，我们推出了UltraVoice，这是首个专为多种细粒度语音风格控制而设计的大规模语音对话数据集。UltraVoice涵盖超过830小时的语音对话，提供了六个关键语音风格维度的指令：情感、语速、音量、口音、语言以及复合风格。在UltraVoice上对SLAM-Omni和VocalNet等领先模型进行微调，可显著增强其细粒度语音风格可控性，同时不损害核心对话能力。具体而言，我们微调后的模型在平均意见得分（MOS）上提升了29.12%-42.33%，在指令遵循准确率上提升了14.61-40.09个百分点。
tldr: UltraVoice是首个面向细粒度风格控制的大规模语音对话数据集（830+小时，涵盖情感、语速、音量、口音、语言及复合风格六个维度），在其上微调可显著提升语音对话模型的风格可控性且不损害核心对话能力。
en_tdlr: UltraVoice is the first large-scale speech dialogue dataset (830+ hours) engineered for fine-grained style control across six dimensions (emotion, speed, volume, accent, language, and composite styles), and fine-tuning on it significantly enhances spoken dialogue models' stylistic controllability without degrading core conversational abilities.
